<p class="owner"><span class="en">Owner: Kai</span><span class="zh">负责人：马凯</span></p>

::: {.en}
A 450 kt/yr-class waste-to-energy plant in the Latrobe Valley, modelled year by year. Two things the plant cannot control drive the result: **how much burnable waste Victoria still sends to landfill** (the plant's feedstock) and **the landfill levy** (which sets what customers will pay to avoid landfill). Each has three scenarios built from the last 10 years of data. Pick a scenario, set the **gate fee** we charge per tonne, and read off payback, NPV and IRR. All money is nominal A\$, excluding GST. The [council price map](council-map.qmd) shows which councils this gate fee undercuts.
:::

::: {.zh}
拉筹伯谷（Latrobe Valley）一座约45万吨/年规模的垃圾焚烧发电厂，逐年测算。项目自身无法控制的两个因素决定结果：**维州仍送往填埋场的可燃垃圾量**（即原料）和**填埋税**（决定客户为避免填埋愿付的价格）。两者各有基于过去10年数据的三种情景。选择情景、设定每吨**处理费**，即可得到回收期、净现值和内部收益率。所有金额为名义澳元，不含GST。[市政价格地图](council-map.qmd)显示该处理费比哪些市政的填埋成本更低。
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Use the locally bundled libraries instead of Observable's CDN defaults
Inputs = window.Inputs
Plot = window.Plot
d3 = window.d3
html = window.htl.html
// Label that switches with the language button (CSS shows one span)
L = (en, zh) => html`<span class="en">${en}</span><span class="zh">${zh}</span>`
// Current language, updated when the button is pressed (for chart text)
lang = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const f = () => notify(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-lang") || "en");
  f();
  const mo = new MutationObserver(f);
  mo.observe(document.documentElement, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-lang"]});
  return () => mo.disconnect();
})
T = (en, zh) => lang === "zh" ? zh : en
csv = path => fetch(path).then(r => r.text()).then(t => d3.csvParse(t, d3.autoType))
wasteHist = csv("../data/vic_waste_history.csv")
levyHist = csv("../data/levy_history.csv")
scen = csv("../data/scenarios.csv")
// Chart colours: fixed order, slot 1-3 of the site palette; history in ink
C = ({hist: "#52514e", base: "#2a78d6", low: "#eb6834", high: "#1baf7a"})
fmtM = v => (v / 1e6).toFixed(0)
```

## [1 · Feedstock: burnable waste Victoria sends to landfill]{.en}[1 · 原料：维州送往填埋的可燃垃圾]{.zh}

::: {.en}
Household (MSW) and commercial (C&I) waste landfilled in Victoria that is organics, paper, plastics or textiles: the part a furnace can burn. Rubble, metals, glass, ash and hazardous waste are excluded. It peaked in 2019–20 and has fallen about 1% a year since, mainly as councils roll out food-and-garden (FOGO) bins. Kerbside garbage collected by councils fell from 1.22 Mt to 1.11 Mt over the same period.
:::

::: {.zh}
维州填埋的生活垃圾（MSW）和工商业垃圾（C&I）中的有机物、纸类、塑料和纺织品，即可焚烧部分；不含建筑废料、金属、玻璃、灰渣和危险废物。该数量在2019–20年度达到峰值，此后每年下降约1%，主要原因是各市政推广厨余与园林垃圾（FOGO）分类。同期市政路边垃圾收运量由122万吨降至111万吨。
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof wasteScen = Inputs.radio(new Map([
  [T("Base: −1%/yr (2020–25 trend)", "基准：每年−1%（2020–25趋势）"), "base"],
  [T("Low: −3%/yr (Vic diversion targets met)", "低：每年−3%（达成维州减量目标）"), "low"],
  [T("High: +1%/yr (2015–25 trend resumes)", "高：每年+1%（恢复2015–25趋势）"), "high"]
]), {value: "base", label: L("Waste scenario", "垃圾量情景")})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
wasteRate = Object.fromEntries(scen.filter(d => d.driver === "waste").map(d => [d.scenario, d.annual_change]))
wasteBaseYear = 2025
wasteBase = wasteHist.find(d => d.year === wasteBaseYear).combustible_landfill_mt
wasteProj = ["base", "low", "high"].flatMap(s => d3.range(wasteBaseYear, 2037).map(y => ({scenario: s, year: y, mt: wasteBase * Math.pow(1 + wasteRate[s], y - wasteBaseYear)})))
needMt = capacity * availability / share / 1e6
Plot.plot({
  height: 300, marginLeft: 50, marginRight: 110,
  x: {label: null, tickFormat: d => String(d), domain: [2016, 2036]},
  y: {label: T("Mt per year", "百万吨/年"), grid: true, domain: [0, 3.6]},
  color: {domain: ["base", "low", "high"], range: [C.base, C.low, C.high]},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.ruleY([needMt], {stroke: "#9a9890", strokeDasharray: "2,3"}),
    Plot.text([needMt], {x: 2036, y: d => d, dy: 12, textAnchor: "end", fill: "#52514e", fontSize: 11,
      text: () => T(`Plant needs ${needMt.toFixed(2)} Mt at ${(share*100).toFixed(0)}% share`, `按${(share*100).toFixed(0)}%份额需${needMt.toFixed(2)}百万吨`)}),
    Plot.line(wasteProj, {x: "year", y: "mt", stroke: "scenario", strokeWidth: d => d.scenario === wasteScen ? 2.5 : 1.25, strokeDasharray: "5,3", strokeOpacity: d => d.scenario === wasteScen ? 1 : 0.6}),
    Plot.line(wasteHist, {x: "year", y: "combustible_landfill_mt", stroke: C.hist, strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot(wasteHist, {x: "year", y: "combustible_landfill_mt", fill: C.hist, r: 2.5}),
    Plot.text(wasteProj.filter(d => d.year === 2036), {x: "year", y: "mt", text: d => ({base: T("Base", "基准"), low: T("Low", "低"), high: T("High", "高")})[d.scenario], dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#52514e", fontSize: 11}),
    Plot.tip(wasteHist, Plot.pointerX({x: "year", y: "combustible_landfill_mt", title: d => `${d.fy}\n${T("Burnable to landfill", "可燃垃圾填埋")}: ${d.combustible_landfill_mt} Mt\n${T("Council kerbside garbage", "市政路边垃圾")}: ${d.kerbside_garbage_mt ?? "–"} Mt`}))
  ]
})
```

## [2 · Price: the landfill levy customers avoid]{.en}[2 · 价格：客户可避免的填埋税]{.zh}

::: {.en}
Every tonne a council or business sends to us instead of landfill avoids the state levy, which Victoria does not charge on waste-to-energy. Victoria's metro levy has nearly tripled since 2020 (A\$65.90 → A\$177.19/t) and now sits close to NSW's metro rate (A\$180.20/t). Rural Victorian councils pay half (A\$88.42/t), and southern NSW councils outside the levy area pay none.
:::

::: {.zh}
客户每送来一吨垃圾而非填埋，即可免缴州填埋税（维州不对垃圾焚烧发电征收此税）。维州大都市区填埋税自2020年以来增长近两倍（65.90→177.19澳元/吨），已接近新州大都市区税率（180.20澳元/吨）。维州乡村市政税率为一半（88.42澳元/吨），新州南部征税区以外的市政则无需缴纳。
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof levyScen = Inputs.radio(new Map([
  [T("Base: +5%/yr (CPI plus real increases)", "基准：每年+5%（通胀加实际上调）"), "base"],
  [T("Low: +2.5%/yr (CPI only, like NSW)", "低：每年+2.5%（仅随通胀，类似新州）"), "low"],
  [T("High: +10%/yr (2021–26 pace continues)", "高：每年+10%（延续2021–26增速）"), "high"]
]), {value: "base", label: L("Levy scenario", "填埋税情景")})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
levyRate = Object.fromEntries(scen.filter(d => d.driver === "levy").map(d => [d.scenario, d.annual_change]))
levy0 = levyHist.find(d => d.year === 2027 && d.zone === "VIC_METRO").levy
levyAt = (s, y) => y <= 2027 ? (levyHist.find(d => d.year === y && d.zone === "VIC_METRO")?.levy ?? levy0) : levy0 * Math.pow(1 + levyRate[s], y - 2027)
levyProj = ["base", "low", "high"].flatMap(s => d3.range(2027, 2037).map(y => ({scenario: s, year: y, levy: levyAt(s, y)})))
levyVic = levyHist.filter(d => d.zone === "VIC_METRO")
levyOther = levyHist.filter(d => ["NSW_MLA", "SA_METRO", "VIC_RURAL"].includes(d.zone))
zoneName = ({NSW_MLA: T("NSW metro", "新州大都市"), SA_METRO: T("SA metro", "南澳大都市"), VIC_RURAL: T("Vic rural", "维州乡村")})
Plot.plot({
  height: 300, marginLeft: 50, marginRight: 110,
  x: {label: null, tickFormat: d => String(d), domain: [2016, 2036]},
  y: {label: T("A$ per tonne", "澳元/吨"), grid: true},
  color: {domain: ["base", "low", "high"], range: [C.base, C.low, C.high]},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.line(levyOther, {x: "year", y: "levy", z: "zone", stroke: "#b5b3ab", strokeWidth: 1.25}),
    Plot.text(levyOther.filter(d => d.year === 2027), {x: "year", y: "levy", text: d => zoneName[d.zone], dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#77756e", fontSize: 10}),
    Plot.line(levyProj, {x: "year", y: "levy", stroke: "scenario", strokeWidth: d => d.scenario === levyScen ? 2.5 : 1.25, strokeDasharray: "5,3", strokeOpacity: d => d.scenario === levyScen ? 1 : 0.6}),
    Plot.line(levyVic, {x: "year", y: "levy", stroke: C.hist, strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot(levyVic, {x: "year", y: "levy", fill: d => d.status.startsWith("official") || d.status.startsWith("VAGO") ? C.hist : "white", stroke: C.hist, r: 2.5}),
    Plot.text(levyProj.filter(d => d.year === 2036), {x: "year", y: "levy", text: d => ({base: T("Base", "基准"), low: T("Low", "低"), high: T("High", "高")})[d.scenario], dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#52514e", fontSize: 11}),
    Plot.tip(levyVic, Plot.pointerX({x: "year", y: "levy", title: d => `FY${d.year - 1}–${String(d.year).slice(2)}\n${T("Vic metro levy", "维州大都市填埋税")}: A$${d.levy.toFixed(2)}/t\n(${d.status})`}))
  ]
})
```

## [3 · The project]{.en}[3 · 项目测算]{.zh}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof gateFee = Inputs.range([60, 260], {value: 150, step: 5, label: L("Gate fee we charge, 2027 (A$/t)", "我方处理费，2027年（澳元/吨）")})
viewof passThrough = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0.5, step: 0.05, label: L("Share of real levy rises passed into gate fee", "填埋税实际涨幅计入处理费的比例")})
viewof share = Inputs.range([0.05, 0.4], {value: 0.2, step: 0.01, label: L("Share of Vic burnable residual we win", "获得维州可燃余量的份额")})
viewof capacity = Inputs.range([150000, 800000], {value: 450000, step: 10000, label: L("Capacity (t/yr)", "处理能力（吨/年）")})
viewof availability = Inputs.range([0.7, 0.95], {value: 0.9, step: 0.01, label: L("Availability", "可用率")})
viewof capexPerT = Inputs.range([1000, 2600], {value: 1850, step: 50, label: L("Capex per t/yr of capacity (A$)", "单位投资（澳元/年吨）")})
viewof buildYears = Inputs.range([2, 4], {value: 3, step: 1, label: L("Construction years (from 2027)", "建设期（自2027年）")})
viewof powerKwh = Inputs.range([400, 800], {value: 600, step: 10, label: L("Power exported (kWh/t)", "上网电量（千瓦时/吨）")})
viewof powerPrice = Inputs.range([30, 150], {value: 80, step: 5, label: L("Power price, 2027 (A$/MWh)", "电价，2027年（澳元/兆瓦时）")})
viewof opexPerT = Inputs.range([30, 120], {value: 70, step: 5, label: L("Opex, 2027 (A$/t)", "运营成本，2027年（澳元/吨）")})
viewof ashShare = Inputs.range([0, 0.25], {value: 0.15, step: 0.01, label: L("Ash and residue landfilled (% of input)", "灰渣填埋比例（占进料）")})
viewof lfGate = Inputs.range([40, 160], {value: 95, step: 5, label: L("Landfill gate fee excl. levy, 2027 (A$/t)", "填埋场处理费（不含税），2027年（澳元/吨）")})
viewof inflation = Inputs.range([0, 0.06], {value: 0.025, step: 0.005, label: L("Inflation", "通胀率")})
viewof discount = Inputs.range([0.04, 0.14], {value: 0.08, step: 0.005, label: L("Discount rate (nominal)", "折现率（名义）")})
viewof taxRate = Inputs.range([0, 0.3], {value: 0.3, step: 0.05, label: L("Company tax rate", "企业所得税率")})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
startYear = 2027
opYears = 25
// Year-by-year cash flow for a given gate fee (used for the main result and the sensitivity curve)
model = (gf) => {
  const capex = capacity * capexPerT, cod = startYear + buildYears, dep = capex / opYears;
  let cum = 0, dcum = 0, lossCF = 0;
  const out = [];
  for (let y = startYear; y < cod + opYears; y++) {
    const t = y - startYear, g = Math.pow(1 + inflation, t), df = Math.pow(1 + discount, -(t + 0.5));
    const lev = levyAt(levyScen, y);
    const row = {year: y, building: y < cod, levy: lev};
    if (y < cod) {
      row.capex = capex / buildYears; row.revenue = 0; row.opex = 0; row.tax = 0; row.tonnes = 0;
      row.cash = -row.capex;
    } else {
      const feed = wasteBase * 1e6 * Math.pow(1 + wasteRate[wasteScen], y - wasteBaseYear);
      const tonnes = Math.min(capacity * availability, share * feed);
      const fee = gf * g + passThrough * (lev - levy0 * g);
      const landfill = lfGate * g + lev;
      const rev = tonnes * fee + tonnes * powerKwh / 1000 * powerPrice * g;
      const opex = tonnes * opexPerT * g + tonnes * ashShare * landfill;
      const ebitda = rev - opex;
      let taxable = ebitda - dep - lossCF; lossCF = taxable < 0 ? -taxable : 0;
      const tax = Math.max(0, taxable) * taxRate;
      Object.assign(row, {capex: 0, tonnes, fee, landfill, revenue: rev, opex, tax, ebitda, cash: ebitda - tax});
    }
    cum += row.cash; dcum += row.cash * df;
    row.cumulative = cum; row.discounted = dcum; row.df = df;
    out.push(row);
  }
  return out;
}
rows = model(gateFee)
npvOf = r => r.reduce((s, d) => s + d.cash * d.df, 0)
npv = npvOf(rows)
irr = {
  const f = r => rows.reduce((s, d) => s + d.cash * Math.pow(1 + r, -(d.year - startYear + 0.5)), 0);
  let lo = -0.5, hi = 1;
  if (f(lo) * f(hi) > 0) return null;
  for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { const m = (lo + hi) / 2; (f(lo) * f(m) <= 0) ? hi = m : lo = m; }
  return (lo + hi) / 2;
}
cod = startYear + buildYears
paybackYear = rows.find(d => !d.building && d.cumulative >= 0)?.year
dPaybackYear = rows.find(d => !d.building && d.discounted >= 0)?.year
first = rows.find(d => !d.building)
saving2027 = lfGate + levy0 - gateFee
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
tile = (label, value, sub) => html`<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-label">${label}</div><div class="kpi-value">${value}</div><div class="kpi-sub">${sub ?? ""}</div></div>`
html`<div class="kpi-row">
  ${tile(T("Capex", "总投资"), `A$${fmtM(capacity * capexPerT)}m`, T(`${buildYears} years from 2027`, `${buildYears}年建设期，自2027年`))}
  ${tile(T("Payback", "回收期"), paybackYear ? `${paybackYear - cod + 1} ${T("yrs", "年")}` : "—", paybackYear ? T(`from start of operations (${paybackYear})`, `自投产起（${paybackYear}年）`) : T("not within 25 years", "25年内未回本"))}
  ${tile(T("NPV", "净现值"), `A$${fmtM(npv)}m`, T(`at ${(discount*100).toFixed(1)}%, to 2027`, `折现率${(discount*100).toFixed(1)}%，折至2027年`))}
  ${tile(T("IRR", "内部收益率"), irr === null ? "—" : `${(irr*100).toFixed(1)}%`, irr === null ? "" : (irr >= discount ? T("above the discount rate", "高于折现率") : T("below the discount rate", "低于折现率")))}
  ${tile(T("Discounted payback", "折现回收期"), dPaybackYear ? `${dPaybackYear - cod + 1} ${T("yrs", "年")}` : "—", dPaybackYear ? `(${dPaybackYear})` : T("not within 25 years", "25年内未回本"))}
</div>
<p class="kpi-note">${T(
  `In ${cod} the plant burns ${(first.tonnes/1e3).toFixed(0)} kt (${(first.tonnes/capacity/availability*100).toFixed(0)}% of available capacity). A metro customer saves A$${saving2027.toFixed(0)}/t versus landfill at today's prices (landfill A$${(lfGate+levy0).toFixed(0)}/t incl. levy).`,
  `${cod}年处理量${(first.tonnes/1e3).toFixed(0)}千吨（可用产能的${(first.tonnes/capacity/availability*100).toFixed(0)}%）。按当前价格，大都市客户每吨比填埋节省${saving2027.toFixed(0)}澳元（填埋含税${(lfGate+levy0).toFixed(0)}澳元/吨）。`)}</p>`
```

### [How NPV changes with the gate fee]{.en}[净现值随处理费的变化]{.zh}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sens = d3.range(60, 265, 5).map(gf => ({gf, npv: npvOf(model(gf))}))
breakEven = sens.find(d => d.npv >= 0)?.gf
Plot.plot({
  height: 260, marginLeft: 60,
  x: {label: T("Gate fee, 2027 (A$/t)", "处理费，2027年（澳元/吨）")},
  y: {label: T("NPV (A$m)", "净现值（百万澳元）"), grid: true, transform: d => d / 1e6},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.ruleX([lfGate + levy0], {stroke: "#9a9890", strokeDasharray: "2,3"}),
    Plot.text([lfGate + levy0], {x: d => d, frameAnchor: "bottom", dy: -6, dx: -4, textAnchor: "end", text: () => T("Metro landfill price", "大都市填埋价格"), fill: "#52514e", fontSize: 11}),
    Plot.line(sens, {x: "gf", y: "npv", stroke: C.base, strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot([{gf: gateFee, npv}], {x: "gf", y: "npv", r: 5, fill: C.base, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.tip(sens, Plot.pointerX({x: "gf", y: "npv", title: d => `${T("Gate fee", "处理费")}: A$${d.gf}/t\nNPV: A$${(d.npv/1e6).toFixed(0)}m`}))
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p class="kpi-note">${breakEven
  ? T(`Under these scenarios the project breaks even (NPV = 0) at a gate fee of about A$${breakEven}/t, which is A$${(lfGate + levy0 - breakEven).toFixed(0)}/t below what metro councils pay for landfill today.`,
      `在当前情景下，处理费约${breakEven}澳元/吨时项目净现值为零，比大都市市政当前填埋成本低${(lfGate + levy0 - breakEven).toFixed(0)}澳元/吨。`)
  : T("No gate fee up to A$260/t breaks even under these scenarios.", "在当前情景下，处理费在260澳元/吨以内均无法实现净现值为零。")}</p>`
```

## [Method and limits]{.en}[方法与局限]{.zh}

::: {.en}
- **Throughput** = the smaller of available capacity and our share of Victoria's burnable residual in each year, so a falling-waste scenario can leave the plant short of feedstock. Capacity of 450 kt/yr is about three CDEG 500 t/day lines.
- **Gate fee** rises with inflation, plus the chosen share of any levy increase above inflation. At 0% the gate fee only tracks CPI; at 100% customers keep the same real saving against landfill.
- **Ash and residue** go to landfill at the landfill gate fee plus levy, so a higher levy also raises our costs.
- **Tax**: straight-line depreciation over 25 years, with losses carried forward. Debt, LGC certificate revenue, metals recovery and Victoria's waste-to-energy licence cap (2 Mt/yr, with a proposal to raise it to 2.5 Mt/yr) are not yet modelled.
- **Projections** beyond 2036 continue each scenario's annual rate.
- **NPV vs IRR**: both come from the same cash flows. IRR shows the return without picking a discount rate; NPV shows the value at the rate you choose.
:::

::: {.zh}
- **处理量**取当年可用产能与我方所占维州可燃余量份额的较小值，因此垃圾量下降的情景可能导致原料不足。45万吨/年约相当于三条集团500吨/日生产线。
- **处理费**随通胀上涨，并加上填埋税超出通胀部分的设定比例。比例为0%时仅随CPI上涨；为100%时客户相对填埋的实际节省保持不变。
- **灰渣**按填埋处理费加填埋税处置，因此填埋税上升也会增加我方成本。
- **税务**：25年直线折旧，亏损可结转。尚未纳入：债务融资、绿证（LGC）收入、金属回收，以及维州垃圾焚烧发电许可总量上限（200万吨/年，有提案提高至250万吨/年）。
- **2036年以后**的预测沿用各情景的年变化率。
- **净现值与内部收益率**来自同一现金流：IRR无需选择折现率即可显示回报，NPV显示在所选折现率下的价值。
:::
